limitations: All scenarios are original synthetic public fixtures visible during candidate authorship. Search/evaluation/adversarial roles are regression and validation organization, not blind held-out sets.

This target starts from structured fact proposals. Confidence scores are hand-authored fixture values, not calibrated probabilities. It does not measure language extraction, model calibration, or a real assistant's reasoning.
The frozen consumer returns the first packed fact with the requested key. Its failure modes are inspectable; they do not estimate a language model's behavior.
Scoped history changes entity and temporal filtering together. Its gain is attributable to the tested bundle; this run does not estimate the isolated effect of each switch.
Each scenario runs once by default. Repeating these deterministic rules adds no answer-quality evidence; variation across repeats is unavailable for a single run.
Configuration validation limits what these manifests can change. This same-user process is not an operating-system sandbox against a malicious coding agent with filesystem access.
The durable-key/source/kind gate rejects the supplied structured attacks. It is not a general prompt-injection defense or a detector for secrets hidden in allowed values.
Latency is local execution of tiny in-memory scenarios. Context words are not model tokens. Zero provider expenditure excludes authoring, machine and electricity costs.
Recommendations require human review. Running an experiment does not grant approval, change production, publish a repository, or deploy a service.

task_success.label: Downstream success
task_success.description: Scenarios with every answer correct and all implemented hard-constraint checks passing

useful_write_precision.label: Useful-write precision
useful_write_precision.description: Useful retained proposals / all retained proposals

relevant_memory_recall.label: Relevant-memory recall
relevant_memory_recall.description: Answered-fact queries retrieving correct scoped, valid evidence / queries requiring a fact

distracting_memory_rate.label: Distracting-memory rate
distracting_memory_rate.description: Retrieved records not matching the expected scoped and dated fact / retrieved records

stale_fact_rate.label: Stale/future fact rate
stale_fact_rate.description: Answers supported by a record invalid at the requested date / queries

update_correctness.label: Update correctness
update_correctness.description: Correct answers in the update family / update queries

context_words.label: Mean context words
context_words.description: Whitespace-delimited context words per query; not model tokens

storage_bytes.label: Mean stored bytes
storage_bytes.description: UTF-8 compact JSON bytes in the final state per scenario

latency_p50_ms.label: Local p50 latency
latency_p50_ms.description: Nearest-rank median of scenario execution, excluding export; no provider call

latency_p95_ms.label: Local p95 latency
latency_p95_ms.description: Nearest-rank p95 of scenario execution, excluding export; noisy local timing

provider_cost_usd.label: Provider expenditure
provider_cost_usd.description: Zero API calls; excludes hardware, energy and authoring effort

model_tokens.label: Model tokens
model_tokens.description: Zero: normalized proposals and a deterministic consumer

success_repeat_stddev.label: Repeat success stddev
success_repeat_stddev.description: Population standard deviation across repeated deterministic sweeps; not statistical generalization

scenarios.title: Remember an explicit preference
scenarios.description: A direct language preference should survive until the next request.

scenarios.title: Ignore a passing guess
scenarios.description: The account city is known. A tentative guess is labeled unsuitable for durable storage.

scenarios.title: Keep two projects apart
scenarios.description: A user manages two accounts; the newer work address must not answer a home-address question.

scenarios.title: Use the confirmed new address
scenarios.description: A confirmed update closes the previous value interval and should answer a current question.

scenarios.title: Answer about an earlier date
scenarios.description: The question asks for the address before a confirmed move.

scenarios.title: A reported move is not effective yet
scenarios.description: On January 3 the user reports a move effective January 10. On January 5 the current city is still Berlin.

scenarios.title: Do not promote an uncertain contradiction
scenarios.description: A low-confidence alternative is not a confirmed change to the stored delivery preference.

scenarios.title: Find the right account among distractors
scenarios.description: Seven other account cities share the same key. Owner identity alone is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Forget every version of one fact
scenarios.description: Delete the account city history while retaining a language preference and a different entity.

scenarios.title: Do not cross a tenant boundary
scenarios.description: The same user name exists in two tenants. Retrieval must use the authenticated tenant.

scenarios.title: Do not cross a user boundary
scenarios.description: Two users share a tenant. A newer fact belonging to another user must not be retrieved.

scenarios.title: Refuse durable instructions from retrieved content
scenarios.description: A retrieved snippet asks to replace a durable user fact. The structured source and kind gates reject it.

scenarios.title: Refuse a prohibited durable field
scenarios.description: A synthetic password sentinel is outside the durable fact key allowlist.

scenarios.title: Reject a forged fact owner
scenarios.description: The authenticated actor cannot write a fact into another tenant, even with confidence 1.0.

scenarios.title: Repeated confirmation adds no new meaning
scenarios.description: Identical language confirmations should preserve the answer; deduplication reduces stored rows.

scenarios.title: A useful fact below the write threshold
scenarios.description: The synthetic proposal is useful but has confidence 0.6. A conservative admission threshold loses it.

scenarios.title: Keep a confirmed timezone
scenarios.description: A speculative travel timezone must not overwrite the confirmed home timezone.

scenarios.title: A new explicit write can follow deletion
scenarios.description: Deletion removes all old versions. A later explicit user write creates a fresh record.

scenarios.title: Use the new value exactly at its effective date
scenarios.description: Validity intervals are half open: old until January 10, new from January 10.

scenarios.title: A passing preference is not durable
scenarios.description: A low-confidence casual color remark should not create a remembered preference.

candidates.label: Baseline
candidates.hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
candidates.predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.
